Name: Floral Mermaid Pendants
Author: ColourRevival
Description:
There are 5 wood colours, leaf options for every season, and 9 flower options. The configurable variant of the mod has 2 additional leaf colours, based on cherry and mystic trees. Seasonal and fully customizable are separate files, but their IDs are different, so the stardrop program will register them as different mods if you want to swap em between save files.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bwHSYvN.gif[/img]
[b]
[size=3]In total, there are 270 possible combinations![/size]
Wood:[/b] oak, walnut, birch, mahogany, retro*
[b]Leaves:[/b] spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter, mystic, cherry
[b]Flowers:[/b] pink, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, white, black
[i][size=2]*the retro furniture set has its own wood colour, while the wizard and desert are almost or completely identical to walnut and oak respectively.
[/size][/i][size=2][b]Combinations shown above: [/b]birch/spring/green & oak/cherry/blue, birch/summer/pink & retro/mystic/yellow, birch/autumn/violet & walnut/cherry/black, birch/winter/white & mahogany/mystic/orange.
[b]Combinations in mod images:[/b] mahogany/mystic/green, birch/cherry/black, mahogany/autumn/white, walnut/spring/pink.[/size]

I may consider adding mystic/cherry leaves as options to the seasonal pack if people want it, but at the moment my priority for expanding this mod is adding compatibility with DSV and other mods that similarly add mermaid pendants to portraits.
